t: 佛罗伦萨人第二次将美第奇人赶出去,佛罗伦萨重新成为一个共和国.
te: The Florentines drive out the Medici for a second time and Florence re-establishes itself as a republic.
dz: 佛罗伦萨人第二次将美第奇人赶出去,佛罗伦萨重新成为一个共和国.
de: The Florentines drive out the Medici for a second time and Florence re-establishes itself as a republic.

t: 莫宁总督萨多 (Thado) 成为阿瓦国王。
te: Gov. Thado of Mohnyin becomes King of Ava.
dz: 莫宁总督萨多 (Thado) 成为阿瓦国王。
de: Gov. Thado of Mohnyin becomes King of Ava.

t: 贝特朗·杜盖克林和法国军队在科谢雷尔击败了坏人查理的盎格鲁-纳瓦拉军队。
te: Bertrand du Guesclin and a French army defeat the Anglo-Navarrese army of Charles the Bad at Cocherel.
dz: 百年战争：贝特朗·杜盖克林和法国军队在科谢雷尔击败了坏人查理的盎格鲁-纳瓦拉军队。
de: Hundred Years' War: Bertrand du Guesclin and a French army defeat the Anglo-Navarrese army of Charles the Bad at Cocherel.

t: 鲍德温九世,佛兰德斯伯爵被加冕为拉丁帝国第一任皇帝.
te: Baldwin IX, Count of Flanders is crowned as the first Emperor of the Latin Empire.
dz: 鲍德温九世,佛兰德斯伯爵被加冕为拉丁帝国第一任皇帝.
de: Baldwin IX, Count of Flanders is crowned as the first Emperor of the Latin Empire.

t: 夺取了罗马控制权的帕特里安·约翰二世·克苏尼乌斯(Patrician John II Cres…
te: Patrician John II Crescentius, who has seized control of Rome, selects Pope John XVII as the new pope.
dz: 夺取了罗马控制权的帕特里安·约翰二世·克苏尼乌斯(Patrician John II Cresentius)选择教宗约翰十七世为新教宗.
de: Patrician John II Crescentius, who has seized control of Rome, selects Pope John XVII as the new pope.

t: 反叛的土耳其军阀加兹尼的马赫穆德在梅尔夫战役中击败了萨马尼德埃米尔曼苏尔二世.
te: Rebel Turkish warlord Mahmud of Ghazni defeats Samanid Emir Mansur II in battle at Merv.
dz: 反叛的土耳其军阀加兹尼的马赫穆德在梅尔夫战役中击败了萨马尼德埃米尔曼苏尔二世.
de: Rebel Turkish warlord Mahmud of Ghazni defeats Samanid Emir Mansur II in battle at Merv.

t: 铃木天皇放弃了王位,支持成为日本第62任皇帝的弟弟村上.
te: Emperor Suzaku abdicates the throne in favor of his brother Murakami who becomes the 62nd emperor of Japan.
dz: 铃木天皇放弃了王位,支持成为日本第62任皇帝的弟弟村上.
de: Emperor Suzaku abdicates the throne in favor of his brother Murakami who becomes the 62nd emperor of Japan.
